summary: L1 engineering audit and safe synchronization of AgentRSI ResearchOps sidecar

payload.mission: Reconcile the local AgentRSI checkout against heng526/AgentRSI main, safely record this engineering audit through the existing ResearchOps sidecar, and verify the resulting GitHub commit and CI.
authorized_now: Inspect repository instructions, actual Git state, remote and existing ResearchOps configuration.
Synchronize only additive, safe engineering records to the verified active target branch using existing authorization.
Use the already-installed ResearchOps schema, reducer, validator, and workflow; append a task and result, then derive state and ledger through the reducer.
Run sidecar structural validation and verify the resulting GitHub commit and relevant CI.
authorized_only_if: Write to main only while the live main ref still matches the locally verified baseline; use a non-forced fast-forward update.
Retain the scientific state as unknown/BOOTSTRAP until the separate node01 audit supplies evidence.
hard_prohibitions: Do not create L3/L4 or scientific experiment tasks; do not train or launch experiments.
Do not change scientific method, data split, labels, metrics, or judge.
Do not invent a scientific head, verified run, or server runtime state; do not claim the node01 audit is complete.
Do not reset, force-push, delete, or upload credentials, caches, weights, raw datasets, or large generated run outputs.
Preserve ignored local staging/provenance assets and all existing files.
required_preflight: Confirm live remote main equals local branch head before any write.
Check tracked content for credential patterns without printing values.
Check nested repository and ignored large/local artifact boundaries.
required_outputs: Append immutable L1 task and engineering result records under actor outboxes.
Derive state, ledger, and managed ResearchOps index with the reducer.
Verify remote commit SHA and workflow/CI outcome.
stop_conditions: Stop remote write if main has advanced, the local worktree is dirty, or the existing sidecar state is not the inspected baseline.
Stop and isolate any tracked credential candidate; do not print its value.
Keep scientific status unasserted pending node01/server evidence.
